summary: Edina won the CCM World Invite (2012 Vizion), beating OMGHA 5-3 in the final. Edina went 6-0 with five shutouts.
OMGHA knocked out the Chicago Reapers 5-4 in the quarterfinals, then edged Milwaukee 4-3 in the semis.
Shattuck St Mary's swept Upper Canada College three times by a combined 27-1.
Woodbridge went 2-0 with shutouts of Neponset (5-0) and Providence Capitals (8-0).
Team Illinois won the CCM World Invite (2013 Tacks), beating Windy City Storm 4-2 in the final.
Chicago Mission went 4-1. They beat Indiana Elite, Madison and Pittsburgh Predators, then won the quarterfinal 6-0 over Team Maryland before losing the semi 2-1 to Windy City.
Chicago Reapers finished the 216 Showcase with a 3-1 win over Anaheim on Sunday, and they're the live #1.
Windy City Storm reached the CCM final after upsetting HB Detroit and Mission.

events.result: Field: Chicago Reapers, Anaheim, Little Caesars, Mid-Fairfield, Syracuse, Cleveland, Nor'easters, Columbus

summary: Chicago Reapers went 3-1, beating Pittsburgh Predators (5-0), CarShield (7-2) and Indiana Elite (6-0) before falling 6-3 to Lehigh Valley.
Pittsburgh Penguins Elite went 1-3-1, with losses to Little Caesars, South Shore Kings and Boston Advantage.
North Jersey Avalanche beat Washington Little Capitals twice (7-0 and 13-2), and Vegas swept LA Jr Kings.
Biggby Coffee went 5-0, including wins over Team Illinois and Vegas.
Chicago Mission went 2-1, losing 6-4 to Vegas, then beating Woodbridge 8-1 and Queen City 6-1.
Mid-Fairfield Elite beat Pittsburgh Penguins Elite twice, and Worcester Shamrocks went 3-0.
Lovell Elite won 1-0 over a 12U Springfield Thunderbirds team.
